title: Harness of Minervini v2 market.candidates response

exit_codes.0: A valid domain envelope was emitted; its status may still be partial, unavailable, or needs_input.
exit_codes.2: The request or arguments were invalid; stdout contains a needs_input error envelope.
exit_codes.3: An unexpected internal contract failure occurred; stdout contains an unavailable error envelope.

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

limit.description: Page size; this controls transport volume, not a recommendation quota.

no_cache.description: Bypass both provider-cache reads and writes for this invocation.

limitations: Nasdaq Trader supplies a current security master, not historical constituents; unsupported historical requests are unavailable.
ETF, SPAC, shell, OTC, preferred, warrant, and unsupported instruments are excluded; complete reason counts and at most min(limit, 20) representative records keep the response dense.
Candidate eligibility is not itself a buy recommendation; ticker.qualify is where a name earns a word.
x-capability-contract.output: Eligible instruments, a bounded exclusion summary, and pagination metadata. Nothing here is graded: no price is read on this path, so no name carries a recommendation word and the page counts only what the filter kept and dropped.

status_meanings.needs_input: The limit or cursor is invalid.
status_meanings.ok: The requested page, including a legitimate empty page, was returned.
status_meanings.unavailable: The required security master is unavailable.

x-capability-contract.summary: Return a filtered, paginated US common-stock and ADR discovery universe.
